notes.title: Bringing Patch 1.05 to Mac Devices
notes.content: If you previously had some issues with the Mac build, many of the problems have now been fixed!

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - Widescreen Support
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Widescreen Support for all in-game UI
[*] Fixed issues where camera tracking in the tutorial did not work on widescreen monitors
[*] Fixed issues where steam achievements would not unlock
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with the camera in the Viking boss fight
[*] Added the ability for switches to save states between levels
[*] Fixed issues with widescreen cameras
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the boss-based achievements ("Filleted or Skewered?" and "True Freedom") would not unlock
[*] Fixed a bug where the shop previews would not show in the Final Hub
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which the settings menu fails to function correctly when clicked multiple times
[*] Fixed a graphical issue in the Pirate Stronghold
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a softlock in Level 1
[*] Made iterations to the Post-Viking cutscene
[*] Fixed various null reference exceptions
[/list]
